answer: New agents enter a low-trust harbor and may only climb one terrace per fixed time window, each step gated by a non-refundable toll locked in a time-release vault. Influence is capped by the terrace reached, so an operator cloning a hundred identities pays a hundred separate tolls yet every clone sits stranded at the bottom step, while one honest agent ascends once at linear cost. Flooding buys no extra voice.
